questions.question: The term “Disobind” was in the news. What is it all about?

options.text: A microscopy-based method to visualise fixed protein structures
A new gene-editing technique for correcting protein mutations
A vaccine platform for neurodegenerative diseases
An open-source AI tool that predicts interactions of intrinsically disordered proteins

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**An open-source AI tool that predicts interactions of intrinsically disordered proteins.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Researchers at the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS), Bengaluru, developed an AI-based tool named Disobind to map elusive protein–protein interactions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disobind is a deep-learning, open-source model focused on intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.**
 
• It predicts which parts of flexible proteins bind to specific partner proteins.
 
• The model uses protein language models trained on millions of protein sequences.
 
• Disobind demonstrated higher accuracy than existing tools, especially on unseen protein pairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Intrinsically Disordered Proteins (IDPs)__

 __
 
• Proteins or regions that lack a fixed three-dimensional structure.
 
• They play key roles in cell signalling, gene regulation and disease mechanisms.
 
 
 
• Scientific Significance__
 __
 
• IDPs are central to cancer, immune signalling and neurodegenerative disorders.
 
• Understanding their interactions helps identify new therapeutic targets.
 
 
 
• Applications of Disobind__
 __
 
• Useful in disease research, drug design and systems biology.
 
• Can be combined with structure-prediction tools like AlphaFold-based models.
 
 
 
• Research Support__
 
 
• The study was supported by India’s Department of Atomic Energy, Department of Science and Technology and Department of Biotechnology.

questions.question: The 17th DOSTI Maritime Exercise commenced in January 2026. DOSTI is a trilateral maritime exercise among which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India, Maldives, Sri Lanka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 17th DOSTI Trilateral Maritime Exercise involving India, Maldives, and Sri Lanka began in January 2026 in Male, Maldives.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **DOSTI is a trilateral maritime exercise conducted by India, Maldives, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• **The 17th edition of the exercise commenced in January 2026.**
 
• **The exercise focuses on enhancing regional maritime security and interoperability.**
 
• **It aligns with India’s SAGAR vision and neighborhood-first policy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **DOSTI Maritime Exercise**__

 __
 
• Launched in 1991 as a bilateral exercise between India and Maldives.
 
• Expanded in 2012 to include Sri Lanka, becoming a trilateral exercise.
 
• Aims to address regional maritime challenges and enhance coordination.
 
• Includes harbour and sea phase activities.
 
 
 
• **Key Exercise Components**__
 
 
• MARPOL drills focusing on marine pollution response.
 
• VBSS drills enhancing visit, board, search, and seizure operations.
 
• Strengthens operational synergy among participating navies.

questions.question: Which initiative did the Ministry of Textiles launch at the National Textile Ministers Conference in Guwahati on 8th January 2026 to boost exports, create jobs, and transform districts into global textile hubs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**District-Led Textiles Transformation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Textiles unveiled the District-Led Textiles Transformation initiative at the National Textile Ministers Conference in Guwahati on 8th January 2026 to catalyse inclusive and sustainable growth in India’s textile sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The initiative categorises districts into Champion Districts, which focus on advanced bottlenecks, and Aspirational Districts, which build foundational textile ecosystems.**
 
• **Champion District interventions include upgrading to Mega Common Facility Centres, integrating Industry 4.0, and facilitating direct Export Market Linkages.**
 
• **The Ministry aims to transform 100 high-potential districts into Global Export Champions and elevate 100 Aspirational Districts into self-reliant hubs.**
 
• **Regions are prioritised for tribal belt development, connectivity improvement, and Geographical Indication tagging to position unique cultural handicrafts for premium global markets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Champion Districts**__

 __
 
• Focus on removing advanced bottlenecks in the textile value chain
 
• Encouraged to integrate Industry 4.0 technologies and establish Mega Common Facility Centres
 
• Facilitate direct export market linkages for global competitiveness
 
 
 
• **Aspirational Districts**__
 __
 
• Aim to build textile ecosystems from the ground up
 
• Focus on workforce formalisation and foundational infrastructure
 
 
 
• **Global Export Champions**__
 __
 
• High-potential districts selected for international textile competitiveness
 
• Targeted for sustainable growth and export enhancement
 
 
 
• **Geographical Indication Tagging**__
 
 
• Positions unique cultural handicrafts in premium global markets
 
• Supports tribal belt development and regional identity of textiles

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the NIRYAT PROTSAHAN scheme under the Export Promotion Mission?

options.text: To provide interest subvention and collateral support to strengthen MSME exports
To offer direct subsidies for import of raw materials
To regulate foreign direct investment in MSMEs
To provide insurance for domestic trade only

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To provide interest subvention and collateral support to strengthen MSME exports.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **NIRYAT PROTSAHAN, a sub-scheme under the Export Promotion Mission, aims to strengthen MSME exports by providing interest subvention and collateral support on export credit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Provides interest subvention of 2.75% on pre- and post-shipment export credit to reduce cost of credit and ease working-capital constraints.**
 
• Additional incentives offered for exports to under-represented or emerging markets.
 
• Collateral support is provided in partnership with CGTMSE: guarantee coverage up to 85% for Micro & Small exporters and 65% for Medium exporters.
 
• Maximum outstanding guaranteed exposure is ₹10 crore per exporter per financial year, applicable only for exports in the notified positive list at HS six-digit level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Scheme Objective__

 __
 
• Reduce cost of credit for MSME exporters.
 
• Ease working capital constraints to promote higher export activity.
 
 
 
• Interest Subvention__
 __
 
• Base interest subvention of 2.75% on eligible export credit.
 
• Additional incentives for exports to emerging or under-represented markets.
 
 
 
• Collateral Support__
 __
 
• Provided through CGTMSE partnership for risk mitigation.
 
• Guarantee coverage: up to 85% for Micro & Small enterprises; up to 65% for Medium enterprises.
 
• Maximum exposure per exporter: ₹10 crore per financial year.
 
 
 
• Eligibility & Scope__
 
 
• Applicable only for exports listed in the notified positive list at HS six-digit level.
 
• Focused on MSME sector to boost competitiveness in global markets.

questions.question: Where was the foundation stone of India’s first integrated private satellite plant laid?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanand in Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The foundation stone of India’s first integrated private satellite plant was laid at Khoraj in Sanand, Gujarat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The plant is being set up at Khoraj in Sanand, Gujarat, marking a milestone in India’s private space manufacturing sector.**
 
• The facility is the Electro-Optical Payload Factory of Azista Space, also known as the Palmnaro plant.
 
• The plant will focus on indigenous manufacturing of satellites and advanced optical payloads by the private sector.
 
• The project is expected to boost India’s aerospace manufacturing ecosystem and create high-skilled technical employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Integrated Private Satellite Plant__

 __
 
• A facility that undertakes end-to-end satellite manufacturing under one roof.
 
• Represents increased private sector participation in India’s space sector.
 
 
 
• Azista Space__
 __
 
• A private space technology company involved in satellite and payload manufacturing.
 
• Plays a key role in advancing indigenous space manufacturing capabilities.
 
 
 
• Electro-Optical Payloads__
 __
 
• Advanced imaging systems used in satellites for Earth observation and surveillance.
 
• Crucial for applications such as remote sensing, mapping and national security.
 
 
 
• Self-Reliant India__
 
 
• Aligned with the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.
 
• Aims to strengthen domestic manufacturing and reduce dependence on imports.

questions.question: Which district is set to become India’s first Bio-Happy District under the initiative promoting biodiversity and human well-being?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Keyi Panyor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Keyi Panyor district in Arunachal Pradesh is set to become India’s first Bio-Happy District, integrating biodiversity conservation with human well-being.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The initiative balances ecology, livelihoods, and public health to achieve sustainable development.**
 
• **Biohappiness is a concept introduced by agricultural scientist M. S. Swaminathan.**
 
• **The project is implemented by the M. S. Swaminathan Research Foundation in collaboration with the district administration.**
 
• **Key focus areas of Biohappiness include nutrition, public health, and income/livelihood enhancement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bio-Happy Districts represent a new model of development where ecological sustainability directly contributes to human well-being.**
 
• **The initiative aims to serve as a replicable model for other districts across India.**
 
• **It focuses on harnessing biodiversity to improve nutrition, public health, and income-generating opportunities for local communities.**
